name: co-agent
description: Collaborate with other AI agents (Kiro CLI, Codex, Agy) — multi-AI code/architecture review, decision support when you're unsure, ADR co-authoring, and autonomous consensus/harness implementation pipelines. Claude chairs in Claude Code; Codex chairs in Codex.

hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ "$(basename "$FILE" 2>/dev/null)" = "CLAUDE.md" ] || exit 0; DIR=$(dirname "$FILE"); SK="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/co-agent/scripts"; OUT=$(python3 "$SK/check_ai_context.py" "$DIR" 2>/dev/null) || { if python3 "$SK/co_agent_config.py" autosync --root "$DIR" 2>/dev/null; then MSG="[co-agent] CLAUDE.md changed and AI context files are stale. Auto-sync is ON — run /co-agent:sync-context $DIR now to regenerate AGENTS.md (Codex) + the Kiro steering bridge."; else MSG="[co-agent] CLAUDE.md changed — AI context files are stale. Run /co-agent:sync-context to regenerate (or enable auto-sync: /co-agent:configure set autosync on)."; [ -n "$OUT" ] && MSG=$(printf "%s\n%s" "$MSG" "$OUT"); fi; jq -n --arg m "$MSG" "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; }; exit 0'

echo 'co-agent loaded. Multi-AI collaboration (Kiro/Codex/Agy): /co-agent review · decide · adr · sync-context · consensus · harness · setup. Tune the panel with /co-agent:configure. The current host synthesizes; uses whichever peer AI CLIs are installed.'
